text: dsh-review-loop 是供 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端使用的增量代码审查插件。它在会话输入框上方加入审查面板，并提供 /review 命令，共用同一份检查点。用户可以查看相对 HEAD 的文件差异、批准已审查批次、在后续审查中只看新增或变更文件，也能附上意见并发送给 agent。检查点按工作区分别保存在 DSH_HOME 下。适合需要持续检查 agent 工作区改动的开发者；需要 DeepSeek Harness、Git 工作区和 Web 客户端。

dsh-review-loop adds a review panel and /review command to DeepSeek Harness web. Shared workspace checkpoints help reviewers inspect changed files, approve batches, revisit later changes, and send comments to the agent. Checkpoints live under DSH_HOME. Requires a Git workspace and web client.
想让 DSH 按上次审查后新增的改动列出待看文件。
有没有办法批准一批代码修改后，只审查后来又变化的文件？
我想在网页会话里直接展开文件差异并逐个查看。
给代码审查结果附上意见，并把反馈发回 agent。
能用一个斜杠命令查看当前工作区相对 HEAD 的改动吗？
希望审查记录跨会话保存，而且不要写进项目仓库。
Show me only files that changed after my last review checkpoint.
I want to inspect and approve agent code changes from the web conversation panel.
dsh-review-loop 的增量审查功能：按工作区检查点中的文件哈希标记已看过的改动，只把新文件或再次变化的文件留在待审队列。使用 /review 查看；批准后推进检查点。
dsh-review-loop 的网页审查面板：在会话输入区显示待审数量，可展开文件列表并查看带颜色区分的差异。面板定期读取会话对应的审查状态。
dsh-review-loop 的审查反馈功能：在批准检查点时可填写评论，插件会将评论作为用户消息注入匹配工作区的 agent。可通过命令或网页面板提交。
dsh-review-loop 的 /review 命令：默认查看自检查点以来的变动，/review all 显示相对 HEAD 的全部工作区改动，/review approve 记录当前检查点。
dsh-review-loop 使用前须知：运行时会在 DSH_HOME/review-loop 下为工作区写入 JSON 检查点文件，并以临时文件重命名保存。
dsh-review-loop 使用前须知：审查针对 Git 工作区；实现通过 git status、diff 和 hash-object 获取变更与文件内容哈希。

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · dsh-review-loop：`dsh-review-loop` turns code review of agent work into an incremental, closed-loop process: after you approve a batch of changes, a checkpoint is recorded and the next review shows only the changes made afterward — never a re-review of what you already saw. Review feedback is injected back to the agent through the harness's normal message channel, without interrupting its work.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · What it solves：An agent task commonly touches a dozen or more files. Reviewing the full diff every time is slow, and re-reviewing unchanged work wastes attention. This plugin makes review follow the agent's progress:

```
agent works (modifies files)
  -> open the review panel: only changes since the last review checkpoint
  -> inspect each file's diff, add feedback
  -> approve: a new checkpoint is recorded, feedback is injected to the agent

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · Features：- **Incremental review (since-review)**: approving snapshots the working tree into a checkpoint; the next review diffs `checkpoint -> current`, so reviewed files disappear from the queue unless they change again.
- **Two entry points**: a Web UI review panel docked above the conversation composer (2s polling), and a `/review` command for keyboard-first use. The same core logic backs both.
- **Feedback closed loop**: approvals may carry a comment, delivered to the agent as a user message via `agent.inject()`.
- **No tool-call parsing**: any on-disk change — by the agent, by you, or by another process — is reflected; the plugin reads git, not the agent loop.
- **Checkpoint persistence**: `$DSH_HOME/review-loop/<workspace-hash>.json`, written atomically, never polluting the workspace's own git status.
- **Zero core modifications**: a pure bundle plugin (`dsh.bundle` patch layer); the agent-loop skeleton is untouched.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · Web UI：In any session whose workspace is a git repository, a review panel appears above the composer:

- A status line — `N file(s) to review` — with an **Open review** button.
- The expanded panel lists the pending files with toggleable, colorized diffs (added lines use the success token, removed lines the error token; the sign is always visible).
- An optional feedback input and an **Approve & checkpoint** button.
- After approval the panel shows the reviewed state; later edits re-surface the file.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · Command line：| Command | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `/review` | Incremental: changes since the last checkpoint (or the full change set vs HEAD when none exists) |
| `/review all` | The complete working-tree change set vs HEAD, ignoring the checkpoint |
| `/review approve` | Record a checkpoint |
| `/review approve <comment>` | Record a checkpoint and inject the comment into the agent |

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · Architecture：```
src/
├── review.ts      Pure core (collectState / approve / renderState) — shared by command and HTTP paths
├── git.ts         git helpers (status / diff / hash-object; zero-dependency spawnSync)
├── checkpoint.ts  checkpoint persistence ($DSH_HOME/review-loop/<ws-hash>.json, atomic write)

@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop README · Architecture：```
command: /review ------> renderState() ----+
                                           +--> src/review.ts (pure, shared)
web UI:  GET /state ----> collectState() --+
         POST /approve --> approve() + agent.inject()

The client bundle is a CJS `__ModuleLoader__` artifact served at `/plugins/@dsh-plugin/dsh-review-loop/client.js`; routes and command share one checkpoint store, so approving from the UI advances the same queue the `/review` command reads.
